name: MonarchTag
title: Tag
summary: A chip for user data: a read-only label, a label the user can remove, or a filter the user can switch on and off.
whenToUse: For labels people add to a record, recipients, and filters above a list.
whenNotToUse: For a status the system sets, such as Draft or Paid, use MonarchBadge. For one choice among several use radio buttons or a segmented control.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTag(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, size: MonarchTagSize = MonarchTagSize.Md, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchTag(text: String, onRemove: () -> Unit, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, size: MonarchTagSize = MonarchTagSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, removeLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchTag(text: String, selected: Boolean, onSelectedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchTagSize = MonarchTagSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, selectedIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchChip(text: String, selected: Boolean, onSelectedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchTagSize = MonarchTagSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, selectedIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchChip(text: String, onRemove: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, size: MonarchTagSize = MonarchTagSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, removeLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Called when the user activates a removable tag. Remove the tag from your data here.

options.name: removeIcon
options.description: The close mark after the text. Decorative; Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: selected
options.description: Whether a selectable tag is on.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the new state when the user toggles the tag.

options.name: tone
options.description: Color role of a read-only or removable tag: Neutral, Info, Success, Warning or Danger.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm uses caption text, Md label text. A read-only tag is 24dp or 28dp high; an interactive one is a 32dp chip with a 48dp touch target.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the user can remove or toggle the tag.

options.name: leadingIcon
options.description: A decorative icon before the text.

options.name: selectedIcon
options.description: Shown in place of leadingIcon while selected, for example a check mark.

options.name: removeLabel
options.description: The TalkBack name of a removable tag. null uses monarch_tag_remove, "Remove" and the text.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press, focus and hover interactions.

states.name: read-only
states.description: A tinted label with no action, read as its text.

states.name: removable
states.description: A Material 3 AssistChip with a trailing close mark; the whole chip removes the tag.

states.name: selected
states.description: Accent fill, accent text and an accent border; selectedIcon replaces the leading icon.

states.name: not selected
states.description: Surface fill, default text and the default border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Muted fill and muted text; the chip does not respond.

appearance: A read-only or removable tag takes the subtle background, strong text and border of its tone; the neutral tag uses the muted background with default text. A selectable tag is the surface color with the default border when off and the accent subtle background, accent strong text and solid accent border when on. Corners are 8dp in every theme.
platformNotes: Planned as a style entry (MonarchTheme over the Material 3 chips); built as a MonarchTag wrapper instead, because the tones, the sizes, the read-only form and the spoken remove name cannot come from the theme alone. iOS also builds MonarchTag. A removable tag follows Material 3 input chips: the whole chip is the remove action (built on AssistChip, because InputChip is selectable and TalkBack would read it as an unchecked checkbox), where the web and iOS have a separate remove button after the label. For the same reason a tag is either removable or selectable, not both. The selectable form has no tone, as on the web, where selectable tags ignore the tone. The web accent tone is not offered, because MonarchTone has none; a selected tag uses the accent. The web TagGroup (arrow-key movement and focus hand-over after a removal) is not offered. Monarch bundles no icons, so the close mark and the check mark are passed by the app. Interactive tags are 32dp, the Material 3 chip height, at both sizes. The selectable and removable forms are MonarchChip: drawn by Monarch (28dp, 8dp corners, no check icon, a drawn close mark when removeIcon is null) with a 48dp touch target, replacing FilterChip, InputChip and AssistChip. Migrating: FilterChip(selected, onClick, label = { Text(t) }) becomes MonarchChip(text = t, selected, onSelectedChange).
accessibility: A read-only tag is not actionable and is read as its text; its icon is hidden from TalkBack.
A removable tag is a button named "Remove" and the text; removeLabel replaces the name.
Delete or Backspace on a hardware keyboard removes a focused, enabled removable tag.
A selectable tag is a checkbox and reports selected or not selected, so the state does not depend on color.
Removable and selectable tags reserve a 48dp touch target and draw the Monarch focus ring around the visible chip.
The leading icon is before the text in both layout directions; text wraps at the largest font size.
edgeCases: Long text wraps inside the tag and the tag grows taller.
Read-only tags are 24dp or 28dp high and interactive ones reserve 48dp, so a row that mixes them has different heights.
A disabled tag keeps muted, not disabled, text, because the label is still information.
Without selectedIcon a selected tag differs from an unselected one by color only to sighted users; TalkBack still reports the state.

    MonarchTag(text = {{items.0.label}}, tone = {{items.0.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag(text = {{items.1.label}}, tone = {{items.1.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag(text = {{items.2.label}}, tone = {{items.2.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag(text = {{items.3.label}}, tone = {{items.3.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag(text = {{items.4.label}}, tone = {{items.4.tone|tone}})
    MonarchTag(text = {{items.5.label}}, tone = {{items.5.tone|tone}})
}

FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    MonarchTag(text = "Neutral", tone = MonarchTone.Neutral)
    MonarchTag(text = "Accent", tone = MonarchTone.Accent)
    MonarchTag(text = "Info", tone = MonarchTone.Info)
    MonarchTag(text = "Success", tone = MonarchTone.Success)
    MonarchTag(text = "Warning", tone = MonarchTone.Warning)
    MonarchTag(text = "Danger", tone = MonarchTone.Danger)
}
